name: stac-trades-smoke
purpose: Bridge smoke for player trading through STAC's chat negotiation: the served policy (one seat) against 3 POMCP-TS-CR and, separately, 3 STAC JSettlers 1.1.16 robots, all trading. Checks that offers in both directions are answered, accepted trades execute, and no turn stalls into a forced end. Bridge health only; not a strength claim.

pomcp_ts_cr.source: Dobre & Lascarides, POMCP with Human Preferences in Settlers of Catan (AIIDE 2018), POMCP-TS-CR; paper setting 10k iterations, 4 threads, C=4 with PUCT, offers limit 3

jsettlers.source: STAC-bundled JSettlers 1.1.16 robot (SOCDefaultRobotFactory, server default parameters: FAST strategy)

limitations: 8 games; bridge health only. Player trades on in both directions through STAC's chat negotiation; our bot never makes counter-offers and rejects counter-offers to its own offers. STAC's MCTS play is not reproducible even when seeded. Fresh seed 20261112 (not used by earlier STAC runs). The MCTS 10 s per-search cap is a deviation from the paper.
predeclared: 2026-11-08 before any trading game; pass bar fixed here.
